why: The chromatic number itself is still bounded 5-7 with no change since the pre-snapshot 2018 lower bound; but post-snapshot work improved the closely related fractional chromatic number lower bound to at least 4 (Matolcsi, Ruzsa, Varga, Zsamboki, arXiv 2311.10069, revised through March 2025) and an ML-derived construction (Mundinger, Pokutta, Spiegel, Zimmer, arXiv 2404.05509, July 2024) extended six-colorings for a two-distance variant, and I could not confidently tell whether the deep dive would treat the fractional chromatic number as part of 'this problem' as Wikipedia states it or as a distinct related quantity.
